about: Substitution table for the program designer (A-9). Each pattern lists its options in the order to try them: the most common choices first, then the rest of the library. 'alias': true marks an entry from assets/exercise-aliases.json; until it is approved, library.substitutes() leaves it out unless include_unapproved is set. equipment copies the library entry (or the alias). level is regression, standard or progression within the pattern (G-20 swaps a disliked mandatory exercise for an allowed regression). competition_variant_of names the competition lift a close variant stands in for (CT-PLO-1, M26). lineage_alias_of marks a second library spelling of the same lift (LB-6): it is never offered as a substitute. reps_unit marks timed or distance work (IL-28). A pattern's fallback is offered after its own options, for the reason given. Built 2026-09-23.

equipment_extensions.trap_bar: A trap (hex) bar. The library has no token for it, and a barbell gym may not have one.

joint_tags.knee-friendly: The variation is commonly chosen as easier on the knees (CT-PT-3).
joint_tags.low-back-friendly: The variation is commonly chosen to protect the lower back (CT-PT-3).
joint_tags.shoulder-friendly: No entries: nothing in 01, 04 or 07 names a variation as easier on the shoulder.
joint_tags.wrist-friendly: No entries: nothing in 01, 04 or 07 names a variation as easier on the wrist.

joint_tag_rule: A tag is written only where there is a stated reason for it, citing CT-PT-3. Everything else stays untagged, and the general rule applies: keep every pain-free pattern and change range, grip or stance, implement, tempo or side for the one that hurts (CT-PT-3).
pattern_aliases_about: Other spellings of the pattern keys, for templates that name patterns their own way. library.pattern_key() also ignores case and punctuation, so 'knee-flexion' is 'knee flexion' without an entry here. incline-press has no pattern of its own: incline pressing sits in horizontal push.

squat.description: Bilateral knee-dominant squat. A-2 slots: 'goblet or front squat' on squat day and 'a second squat pattern' on deadlift day.

options.name: Leg Press

joint_tags.knee-friendly: High foot placement reduces knee stress (CT-PT-3); holds only with 'High foot' in Notes

options.note: Write 'High foot' in Notes when chosen for the knees.

options.name: Safety Bar Squat
options.note: A squat back-down variant (CT-PLO-15); needs a safety squat bar although the library lists only barbell and rack.

options.name: Squat
options.note: Competition lift and the default spelling (LB-6); high bar by default (L-17).

options.name: Low Bar Squat
options.note: For powerlifters who already squat low bar (L-17).

options.name: Box Squat

joint_tags.knee-friendly: A box sets a safe, repeatable depth for the knees (CT-PT-3)

options.note: The library's Box Squat is the barbell version; a goblet box squat goes in Notes.

options.name: Smith Machine Squat
options.note: Closest library name to a Smith front squat.

options.name: Back Squat
options.note: The same lift as Squat under another key (LB-6): use only when the lifter's lineage already uses this spelling.

hinge.description: Hip hinge: the deadlift family and Romanian deadlift variants. A-2 slot: 'RDL or hamstring' on deadlift day.

options.name: Romanian Deadlift
options.note: A deadlift-day accessory; a close deadlift variant under M26.

options.name: Trap Bar Deadlift

joint_tags.low-back-friendly: Standing inside the bar reduces lower-back shear (CT-PT-3)

options.note: Alias pending approval. Needs a trap bar.

options.name: Deadlift
options.note: Competition lift and the default spelling (LB-6).

options.name: Pause Deadlift
options.note: Alias pending approval; M26 option A and LB-9.

options.name: Rack Pull
options.note: Reduced range from the pins; not used in 01 or 07.

options.name: Sumo Deadlift
options.note: The other stance, for back-downs in the stance the lifter doesn't compete in.

options.name: Conventional Deadlift
options.note: The same lift as Deadlift under another key (LB-6).

horizontal push.description: Horizontal and incline pressing. A-2 slots: 'DB press' on bench day, 'incline DB press' and 'push-ups' on OHP day.

options.name: Incline Push Up
options.note: CT-ADF-6: incline push-up regressions until the lifter meets the test standard.

options.name: Floor Press
options.note: Reduced-range bench; not used in 01 or 07.

vertical push.description: Overhead pressing: the OHP main lift and its substitutes.

options.name: Overhead Press
options.note: House main lift and the default spelling (LB-6).

options.name: Landmine Press
options.note: Alias pending approval. Needs a landmine.

options.name: Military Press
options.note: The same lift as Overhead Press under another key (LB-6).

horizontal pull.description: Rows. A-2 slots: 'row or chin' on bench day and 'row' on OHP day; pressing is paired with pulling.

vertical pull.description: Pull-ups, chin-ups and pulldowns. A-2's 'row or chin' slot; pull-ups are mandatory for ADF Special Forces candidates (CT-ADF-9, CT-ADF-14).
vertical pull.fallback_reason: A-2's slot is 'row or chin', and pressing is paired with pulling: a row fills it where there is no pull-up bar or cable.

options.name: Dumbbell Pullover (Back Focus)
options.note: Shares IronLedger's lift key with Dumbbell Pullover (LB-5).

single-leg/lunge.description: Unilateral leg work, on squat or deadlift day; CT-RGO-3's unilateral leg work.

options.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
options.note: The barbell version goes in Notes.

joint_tags.knee-friendly: Easier on the knees than forward lunges or running (CT-PT-3)

knee flexion.description: Hamstring curls and Nordics. A-2's 'RDL or hamstring' slot; Nordics for rugby (CT-RGO-5, CT-RGI-6).

options.name: Nordic Curl
options.note: Mandatory for rugby, or a regression (CT-RGO-5), built up progressively.

hip extension.description: Glute-dominant hip extension: thrusts, bridges and back extensions.

hip adduction/abduction.description: Adductor and abductor work. The library counts both as glutes (LB-8).

options.name: Machine Curl
options.note: Never the target for a hamstring curl (LB-3).

elbow extension.description: Triceps: A-2's 'laterals or triceps' slot on bench day.

lateral delt.description: Side-delt work: A-2's 'laterals or triceps' slot; DB lateral raises often carry 'AMRAP Last Set'. The library has no delt heads (LB-8).

rear delt/upper back.description: Rear delts and upper back: face pulls, rear-delt flyes and Y raises.
rear delt/upper back.fallback_reason: Rear-delt isolation needs dumbbells, cables or a machine; pressing is paired with pulling, so a row keeps the upper-back pull.

options.name: Y Raise
options.note: Alias pending approval; used as movement prep.

chest fly.fallback_reason: With no fly equipment, a press keeps the chest work in the slot.

shrug.description: Trap elevation: shrugs, on OHP or pull days.

anti-extension core.description: Trunk bracing against extension: planks, dead bugs, rollouts. A-1 closes each day with trunk work; CT-PT-1 finishes with a carry or a core exercise.

joint_tags.low-back-friendly: Paired with the Pallof press to protect the lower back (CT-PT-3)

anti-rotation core.description: Trunk bracing against rotation and side-bending: Pallof press, side plank, controlled woodchops.

joint_tags.low-back-friendly: Anti-rotation core work, chosen to protect the lower back (CT-PT-3)

options.name: Cable Woodchop
options.note: A controlled rotation rather than a pure anti-rotation hold.

trunk flexion.description: Trunk flexion finishers: crunches, weighted V-sits, GHD sit-ups, hanging leg raises; sit-up practice for ADF (CT-ADF-6).

lateral flexion.description: Side bends, a common squat-day finisher.
lateral flexion.fallback_reason: Until the side-bend alias is approved, a lateral-core library exercise closes the day (A-1 trunk work).

carry.description: Loaded carries and lift-and-carry tasks: farmer's carries, CT-PT-1's carry finisher, CT-ADF-9's carries and lift to a platform.
carry.fallback_reason: CT-PT-1 finishes a session with 'a carry or a core exercise', and the library has only one carry.

calf.description: Calf raises: for example single-leg calf raises 5 x 15 on deadlift day; calf raises in CT-FEM-6's program.

neck.description: Neck work 2 times a week for rugby (CT-RGO-11). The library has none, so every option is an alias that needs approval.

power.description: Jumps, throws and Olympic-lift derivatives. For rugby they stop at 20 to 25% velocity loss or RIR 3 or more (CT-RGO-12).

conditioning.description: Aerobic and interval work. Never import rows: it goes in the hand-over, with a 'Then: ...' Notes segment on the day's first row (IL-28). Sprints only when pain-free (CT-PT-7).

options.name: Sprint
options.note: Alias pending approval; CT-RGO-4 max-velocity sprinting.

options.name: Sled Push
options.note: Optional for acceleration; never replaces unresisted sprints (CT-RGO-4).
